note: The page is the small loader loading React 18.3.1 from cdnjs and the public npm package mosaico-page@1.0.3 from jsDelivr with an integrity value. This version adds a strip on every view showing who the connector is working as, with a Stop acting button (PR 2267), a 12-second read timeout so a call that claude.ai drops shows 'could not be read' with Retry instead of loading forever, and the daily brief capped at 8 seconds with a per-call read cache (PR 2268). 67 tools unchanged. The page's background video is not shipped; copies keep the static background.
